# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For any new or modified code, add or update relevant tests and run them to ensure new untested code is not introduced and existing test coverage is maintained.
- Do not remove, disable, or bypass failing tests; treat failures as signals of possible code defects and fix code/tests to validate correct behavior instead of masking issues.
- Don't pull/fetch/commit to git. Only run commands for the local project
